ambiguity_rule: UNIQUE OUTPUT ONLY WHEN CALIBRATED POSTERIOR AND MARGIN GATES PASS; OTHERWISE RETURN A SET OR ABSTAIN

components.detector_head: calibrated fault probability with fixed fault-free threshold
components.fusion: behavior-to-node metric retrieval followed by graph-constrained reranking

graph_encoder.input: normalized directed netlist graph with portable semantic node/edge features

components.locator_head: ranked node/candidate-set probabilities with ambiguity preservation
components.polarity_head: SA0/SA1 probability only after a candidate site is proposed

response_encoder.architecture: masked temporal MLP or 1D convolution with circuit-independent dimensions
response_encoder.input: external/probe delta tensors and validity masks only

components.verification_adapter: optional frozen V1 support when its feature contract is valid; otherwise unavailable

model_family: CIRCUIT-NORMALIZED GRAPH ENCODER + RESPONSE ENCODER + CROSS-MODAL RETRIEVAL/RERANKING
normalization: graph statistics normalized per circuit using TRAIN-frozen rules
no circuit name, path, source label, site index, or partition token
response lengths represented by masks rather than circuit identity
serialization: NPZ/JSON or safe tensor format preferred; executable pickle prohibited for public release
